story.summary: Modern English's "I Melt With You" reached #76 on the Billboard Hot 100. "I Melt with You" is a song by the British new wave band Modern English. The song, produced by Hugh Jones, was the second single from their 1982 album After the Snow.
story.fullStory:
Modern English's "I Melt With You" reached #76 on the Billboard Hot 100. "I Melt with You" is a song by the British new wave band Modern English.

The song, produced by Hugh Jones, was the second single from their 1982 album After the Snow.

It became the band's most successful single, largely in the United States, where it was featured in the film Valley Girl and on MTV.

The song peaked at #76 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 17 weeks on the chart.
